definition: חֶ֫רֶט noun [masculine] graving-tool, stylus — 1. graving-tool , with which Aaron fashioned ( וַיָּצַר ) the molten calf Exod 32:4 ( E ). 2. stylus , for writing on tablet ( גִּלָּיוֺן ): כְּתֹב עָלָיו בְּחֶרֶט אֱנוֺשׁ Isa 8:1 write on it with a man's (i.e. an ordinary) stylus = in common characters, intelligible to all (see Benz Archaeology 290 ).

BDB3116 [H2747]

BDB3115 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB3117

חֶ֫רֶט noun [masculine] graving-tool, stylus —

1. graving-tool, with which Aaron fashioned (וַיָּצַר) the molten calf Exod 32:4 (E).
2. stylus, for writing on tablet (גִּלָּיוֺן): כְּתֹב עָלָיו בְּחֶרֶט אֱנוֺשׁ Isa 8:1 write on it with a man's (i.e. an ordinary) stylus = in common characters, intelligible to all (see BenzArchaeology 290).
